tools.name: search_recalls
tools.description: Search vehicle safety recall notices from seven national and European registers (NHTSA, Transport Canada, DVSA, EU Safety Gate, RDW, MLIT, Israel) by recall number, make and model, or a plain-language description of the problem in any language (e.g. "brakes fail on 2019 Honda CR-V"). Returns titles

tools.name: get_recall_notice
tools.description: Get one recall notice kept by CarsMultiverse: title, summary, register, dates, an excerpt of the notice and a citation. Pass a recall number or a CarsMultiverse URL or path.

tools.name: check_vehicle
tools.description: Check one vehicle for safety recalls: by VIN (decoded worldwide with NHTSA vPIC), or by make, model and model year. Returns every American recall campaign that may cover it (with do-not-drive and park-outside warnings, and whether the wording was rewritten after publication) plus matching notices fr

tools.name: list_registers
tools.description: List the seven recall registers CarsMultiverse keeps, with their authorities and index pages.

labels.name: compare_vehicles
labels.description: Compare two cars by their US recall record: distinct NHTSA recall campaigns since 2012, do-not-drive and park-outside campaigns, and a 0-100 recall load, plus the campaign count for one model year when a year is given. Counts, not a safety rating.

labels.name: this_week
labels.description: What entered the recall record in the last seven days: stop-driving and park-outside warnings (US and UK), new US notices, new UK recalls, and official notices that were rewritten after publication.

labels.name: list_registers
labels.description: List the seven recall registers CarsMultiverse keeps, with their authorities and index pages.
